title: SONGESAND bed frame with 4 storage boxes
productName: SONGESAND bed frame with 4 storage boxes
description: SONGESAND bed frame with 4 storage boxes, brown/Lönset, Full/Double A sturdy bed frame with soft, profile edges and high legs. A classic shape that will last for many years. Also, there are spacious storage boxes under the bed where you can store bedding or clothes.
features: LÖNSET slatted bed base is included in the price, but is packaged separately.

Coordinates with other furniture in the SONGESAND series.
